er_scav_event_desc:
埃莉诺替你找了一片还没翻过的废料，又把松动的铁板挪到一旁。
“你翻那边，我替你看着。”

Eleanor has found a patch of scrap no one has searched yet and moved the loose metal sheets aside.
“You search over there. I'll keep watch.”
